attractions.name: Nusa Penida
attractions.description: Island with stunning west coast exploration including Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, and Broken Beach

attractions.name: Kelingking Beach
attractions.description: Iconic cliff viewpoint shaped like a T-Rex

attractions.name: Angel's Billabong
attractions.description: Natural infinity pool carved into the coastal rocks adjacent to Broken Beach. During calm sea conditions, crystal-clear waters reveal beautiful rock formations beneath the surface.

attractions.name: Broken Beach
attractions.description: Dramatic natural rock arch forming a circular cove with waves rolling through the opening

attractions.name: Kelingking Beach Viewpoint
attractions.description: Often referred to as the 'T-Rex Cliff' due to its distinctive shape. Nusa Penida's most famous viewpoint with sweeping views of white sands, crashing waves, and endless shades of blue.

attractions.name: Diamond Beach
attractions.description: Turquoise waters, white cliff walls, and dramatic rock formations shaped like diamonds

attractions.name: Atuh Beach
attractions.description: A calm, quieter beach with arch-shaped rock formations and soft sand

attractions.name: Tree House Molenteng
attractions.description: Instagram-famous viewpoint overlooking the entire bay

attractions.name: Kelingking Beach (Viewing Point Only)
attractions.description: Famous 'T-Rex cliff' formation with turquoise water crashing against towering limestone walls

attractions.name: Bubu Beach
attractions.description: Beach where you can actually swim with typically clear and inviting water

attractions.name: Broken Beach (Pasih Uug)
attractions.description: Naturally formed coastal arch where the ocean flows through a circular opening into a stunning turquoise lagoon. Dramatic geological formation with rugged limestone cliffs.

attractions.name: Manta Bay
attractions.description: One of Nusa Penida's most sought-after marine experiences offering the chance to snorkel alongside majestic manta rays. Also home to colourful tropical fish, vibrant coral reefs, and sea turtles.
attractions.hours: Best Snorkelling Hours: 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM (subject to sea and weather conditions)

attractions.name: Manta Bay, Gamat Bay, The Wall & Crystal Bay Snorkelling
attractions.description: Snorkelling excursion to four of Nusa Penida's most renowned marine locations. Opportunity to spot manta rays at Manta Bay, colourful coral gardens at Gamat Bay and The Wall, and clear waters at Crystal Bay.
attractions.hours: Subject to weather and sea conditions

safety_tips.tip: Seas can occasionally be choppy — mild motion sickness tablets are recommended
All snorkelling activities at Manta Bay are subject to local safety assessments on the day as marine sightings depend on weather and sea conditions.

transport_options.description: Crossing from mainland Bali to Nusa Penida island
Speedboat transfer from Sanur Harbour to Nusa Penida across the Bali Strait. Journey takes approximately 35–45 minutes. Speedboats generally operate from 7:30 AM onwards.
